newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean offers mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean offers mostly steady to up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly steady to higher on Tuesday while corn values were flat to slightly weaker.
Dealers noted scant farm sales in both corn and soybeans.
On the export front, Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group will tender on Wednesday for 56,000-60,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 corn, traders said.
Also, the Commodity Credit Corp was seeking on August 12, up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for donation to Pakistan.
Shipment period was slated for August 24-September 18.
Soft red winter wheat and hard red winter wheat FOB values were unchanged.
